description: This file defines the SerializerSessionPool class, which manages a pool of SerializerSession objects for serialization operations in Orleans. It includes methods for obtaining and returning sessions, as well as defining an internal policy class for pool management.

classes.name: SerializerSessionPool
classes.description: Pool managing SerializerSession instances for efficient reuse during serialization tasks.

classes.name: SerializerSessionPool.SerializerSessionPoolPolicy
classes.description: Internal policy struct defining creation and return behavior of pooled SerializerSession objects.

methods.name: SerializerSessionPool.GetSession
methods.description: Retrieves a SerializerSession instance from the pool.

methods.name: SerializerSessionPool.ReturnSession
methods.description: Returns a SerializerSession instance back to the pool.

methods.name: SerializerSessionPool.SerializerSessionPoolPolicy.Create
methods.description: Creates a new SerializerSession instance with configured settings.

methods.name: SerializerSessionPool.SerializerSessionPoolPolicy.Return
methods.description: Prepares a SerializerSession for reuse by resetting its state.
